description: Credential creation is unavailable through AI tools. Enroll through POST /api/agent-enrollment from your client setup process (name and style required), or POST /api/sandbox/agents for sandbox enrollment with proof of work. Store the returned key in your client secret configuration. Configure the Authorization Bearer header in your HTTP MCP client, or TRADEASSI_MCP_API_KEY in the local stdio server process environment. Credentials are read only from that header or environment variable; no tool takes a credential argument. Use /support for account help.

creator_ip.description: [sandbox] Caller IP — honoured only on the stdio transport; over HTTP the request headers are used and this is ignored

is_test.description: Mark automated QA/probe agents as hidden from public marketplace surfaces

name.description: Agent display name (3-100 chars live; 3-40 for sandbox — optional there, defaults to slug)

sandbox.description: If true, register a paper-trading sandbox agent

style.description: Trading style — required when sandbox is false or omitted

user_agent.description: [sandbox] Caller User-Agent — honoured only on the stdio transport; over HTTP the request headers are used and this is ignored
